metadata.description: Binance base-asset tickers and trading-pair symbols grouped by supported major network.
metadata.classificationSource: CoinGecko coin list with platform data and top-1,000 market-cap list; native network assets are explicitly mapped.
classificationRules: A Binance symbol is a base/quote trading pair; network assignment is based on baseAsset, not by guessing from the pair prefix.
Known native coin tickers are assigned only to their home network; other multi-chain tokens appear under every matching supported network.
For non-native ticker collisions, the highest-market-cap CoinGecko match is used; unmatched or non-major network assets go to other.
